name: form-field
title: Form field
description: Label, text input, and textarea with an accent focus ring.

variants.name: textarea
variants.description: Multi-line input via `data-variant="textarea"` on the textarea.

docs: A wrapping `<label class="uif-field">` binds the visible label to its control without ids. The focus ring uses the accent role; hover deepens the border. Keep `min-height` at the 44px touch floor on inputs.
